title: Test pressing approval: {artist} – {title}
subtitle: As of {date} · vinyl-check {version} · measured against the digital master of each side, latest recording of each copy
table_hint: Clicks and pops: per minute of music that the master does not explain. Speed: cut and pressing against the master (turntable factored out where it has been set up). Treble: 10 kHz at the end of the side compared with the start.
loud_head: Audible spots on several copies (stamper / cut)
thresholds: Thresholds (a suggestion, not a standard): cut speed ±{cut_ok:.1f} % (note up to ±{cut_warn:.1f} %), center hole {ecc_ok:.2f} mm (note up to {ecc_warn:.2f} mm), pre-echo from {pre_echo:.0f} dB, copies NM/VG+ in the median. Audible spots on all copies: up to {stamper_max} per side are a note to the pressing plant, more mean “do not approve”. “Do not approve” also when speed or center hole are clearly off; a single bad copy is no reason against the whole run.
timeline_hint: Tracks at the top. Row “Stamper”: spots that sit at the same place (±3 ms) on at least two copies (red: on all {copies}, orange: on several; thick and labelled: audible, strength from {audible}). Below, per copy, all {real} real clicks (only on the vinyl according to the master): {pop} pop, {click} click, {tick} crackle; size by strength, outlined = audible.
sg_head: Spectrogram of {copy} with the stamper spots
zoom_head: Audible stamper spots in the spectrogram, per copy (±{s:.2f} s)
zoom_hint: The red marks at the top and bottom show the spot; a click in the stamper appears on every copy as the same thin vertical line exactly there.
curves_head: Frequency response, wow, level per track
levels_title: Level per track vs. master (dB, median = 0)
